hints.title: Weighted Graph Shortest Path
hints.text: Model edge repair costs as edge weights in a structured search.

hints.title: Priority Queue Search
hints.text: Run a priority search starting at node 0 to find the minimum cumulative repair cost to reach node n - 1.

hints.title: Handle Unreachable Cases
hints.text: If node n - 1 cannot be reached through any combination of intact and repairable edges, return -1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth-first search without priority weights fails on graphs with non-uniform repair costs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Adjacency list and priority queue take O(V + E) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects standard Dijkstra shortest path implementation with priority queue.
